dialogues.jp: 「泣いてる暦先生……貴重だったな」
dialogues.en: "A crying Koyomi-sensei... now that's rare."
dialogues.text: "A crying Koyomi-sensei... now that's rare."

dialogues.jp: 俺は呟いた。
dialogues.en: I said in a low voice.
dialogues.text: I said in a low voice.

dialogues.jp:
暦先生とことりとが抱きしめ合って泣いた、あ
の後。
dialogues.en:
It was now well after the time when Koyomi-sensei embraced
Kotori while crying.
dialogues.text:
It was now well after the time when Koyomi-sensei embraced
Kotori while crying.

dialogues.jp:
もう一度ことりに歌って欲しいという列席者の
声がうるさくなったので、俺達はこうして会場
から抜け出してきたのだ。
dialogues.en:
The crowd was baying for an encore, so we snuck out of the
stage when we had the chance.
dialogues.text:
The crowd was baying for an encore, so we snuck out of the
stage when we had the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「くすっ……そうだね。ぼろぼろ泣いてるのを
　見たのは、初めてかな……」
dialogues.en:
"Hehe... yeah. It's the first time I've seen her cry so
strongly."
dialogues.text:
"Hehe... yeah. It's the first time I've seen her cry so
strongly."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、涙だったら、前にも見たことがあるん
　だよ」
dialogues.en: "But, it isn't the first time I've seen her tears."
dialogues.text: "But, it isn't the first time I've seen her tears."

dialogues.jp: 手を繋ぎ、商店街をゆっくりと歩いている。
dialogues.en:
We held hands, as we walked slowly down the shopping
district.
dialogues.text:
We held hands, as we walked slowly down the shopping
district.

dialogues.jp:
５月の陽気はさすがに強く、街行く人も薄着に
なっているようだった。
dialogues.en:
May's weather was quite sunny, so the people walking down
the road were lightly dressed.
dialogues.text:
May's weather was quite sunny, so the people walking down
the road were lightly dressed.

dialogues.jp:
季節が移り変わっていることを、目でも肌でも
実感する。
dialogues.en:
The changes that occured with the changing of seasons was
occuring before my eyes.
dialogues.text:
The changes that occured with the changing of seasons was
occuring before my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私が、子供の頃の話だけどね」
dialogues.en: "It was when I was just a kid."
dialogues.text: "It was when I was just a kid."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「初めて“お姉ちゃん”って呼んだ時に、ね」
dialogues.en: "The first time I called her "sis"."
dialogues.text: "The first time I called her "sis"."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「その時にね、私はこう思ったの」
dialogues.en: "I still remember what she said that day."
dialogues.text: "I still remember what she said that day."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「“ああ、もっと早くそう呼んでいれば良かっ
　たのに”って……」
dialogues.en: ""Ahh, I wish you had called me that much earlier"..."
dialogues.text: ""Ahh, I wish you had called me that much earlier"..."

dialogues.jp:
昔を懐かしむような顔と口調。確かにそれは、
昔のことになってしまっている。
dialogues.en:
She talked with a nostalgic look on her face. Of course,
that's just in the past.
dialogues.text:
She talked with a nostalgic look on her face. Of course,
that's just in the past.

dialogues.jp: 今とは違う、昔に。
dialogues.en: That was the past. This is the present.
dialogues.text: That was the past. This is the present.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うふふ〜」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe~"
dialogues.text: "Ehehe~"

dialogues.jp:
指をきゅっと絡め、腕にぴたりとひっついてく
る。
dialogues.en:
Her fingers held my hand tighter, her arm moving closer to
mine.
dialogues.text:
Her fingers held my hand tighter, her arm moving closer to
mine.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「恋人だもん、ね」
dialogues.en: "We're lovers after all."
dialogues.text: "We're lovers after all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「暑苦しいけどな」
dialogues.en: "Getting a little hot, hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Getting a little hot, hmm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Uh~"
dialogues.text: "Uh~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうせならこれくらいの方がいい」
dialogues.en: "Well, then I'd play along."
dialogues.text: "Well, then I'd play along."

dialogues.jp:
すっと腕を抜き、細い腰に回して、強く引き寄
せた。
dialogues.en:
I suddenly let go of her hand, then put my arm around her
thin waist, pulling her closer to me.
dialogues.text:
I suddenly let go of her hand, then put my arm around her
thin waist, pulling her closer to me.

dialogues.jp:
足が乱れる。肩の辺りに、ことりの顔が乗っかっ
てきた。
dialogues.en:
Our walking speed was quickly mixed up, and her face ended
up on my shoulder.
dialogues.text:
Our walking speed was quickly mixed up, and her face ended
up on my shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……歩きにくいね」
dialogues.en: "...I walked too fast."
dialogues.text: "...I walked too fast."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、急ぐ先がある訳でもなし。ゆっくり行け
　ばいいだろう」
dialogues.en: "No reason to. Let's just walk slowly."
dialogues.text: "No reason to. Let's just walk slowly."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「俺らには、時間がたっぷりあるんだからな」
dialogues.en: "We have plenty of time, after all."
dialogues.text: "We have plenty of time, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの重みが預けられてくる。“人”ってい
う字だな、こりゃ。
dialogues.en:
Kotori strongly nodded her head. We continued with our
人-shape walking.
dialogues.text:
Kotori strongly nodded her head. We continued with our
人-shape walking.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「結局私は、臆病者だったんだね……」
dialogues.en: "In the end, I was just a coward..."
dialogues.text: "In the end, I was just a coward..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: さっきの話だけど、とことりは呟いた。
dialogues.en: She barely whispered what she had said just now.
dialogues.text: She barely whispered what she had said just now.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「臆病で……それで、求めすぎていた。絶対な
　んて、ほんとはないのにね……」
dialogues.en:
"I was cowardly... that's why I wanted it. But in the end,
it make no difference..."
dialogues.text:
"I was cowardly... that's why I wanted it. But in the end,
it make no difference..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「臆病じゃない人間なんて、たぶん、そんなに
　居ない。それに、蛮勇が偉いわけでもない」
dialogues.en:
"There isn't a person alive that doesn't have any cowardice
in him. It's not good to be courageously foolhardy either."
dialogues.text:
"There isn't a person alive that doesn't have any cowardice
in him. It's not good to be courageously foolhardy either."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ことりが臆病なくらいには、俺だって臆病だ
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"And even if you call yourself cowardly, I am too, just as
much."
dialogues.text:
"And even if you call yourself cowardly, I am too, just as
much."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え〜……ほんとに？」
dialogues.en: "Eh~...really?"
dialogues.text: "Eh~...really?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、ほんと。いつかことりに愛想を尽かさ
　れる日が来るんじゃないかと、戦々恐々の毎
　日だ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, really. I was always scared that there may be one day
you decided not to grace me with your presence anymore."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, really. I was always scared that there may be one day
you decided not to grace me with your presence anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「んふふ〜」
dialogues.en: "Eheheh~"
dialogues.text: "Eheheh~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「な、何だよ。変に笑っちゃって」
dialogues.en: "W, what's with that weird laugh."
dialogues.text: "W, what's with that weird laugh."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「抱きしめ合おうか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to hug?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to hug?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……なにっ！？　ここでか？」
dialogues.en: "...What!? Here?"
dialogues.text: "...What!? Here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「テレパシーがなくなっちゃって。言葉と行動
　で気持ちを伝えなくちゃいけないんだもん」
dialogues.en:
"I don't have telepathy anymore. I can only rely on words
and actions for communication."
dialogues.text:
"I don't have telepathy anymore. I can only rely on words
and actions for communication."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それとも……朝倉君には別の伝え方があるの
　かな？」
dialogues.en: "Unless you have some other way for us to communicate?"
dialogues.text: "Unless you have some other way for us to communicate?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　お、俺か？　う〜ん……」
dialogues.en: "Eh? M, me? Errr...."
dialogues.text: "Eh? M, me? Errr...."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「後でね、身内だけの集まりがあるの……朝倉
　君も、来てくれるよね？」
dialogues.en:
"Later, all my relatives are going to meet up... will you
come as well, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text:
"Later, all my relatives are going to meet up... will you
come as well, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「俺も？」
dialogues.en: "Me?"
dialogues.text: "Me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「その場で何を言ってくれるか……私、期待し
　ちゃうなあ……」
dialogues.en: "I hope that would be a...hrm, how do you say it..."
dialogues.text: "I hope that would be a...hrm, how do you say it..."

dialogues.jp: 言葉通り、期待に満ちた視線を向けてくる。
dialogues.en: She looked at me expectantly.
dialogues.text: She looked at me expectantly.

dialogues.jp: 「何を言うか……ね」
dialogues.en: "What would you call it, eh."
dialogues.text: "What would you call it, eh."

dialogues.jp: 「……アメリカンジョーク？」
dialogues.en: "...An American joke?"
dialogues.text: "...An American joke?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ぶぶ〜」
dialogues.en: "Buzzz."
dialogues.text: "Buzzz."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……オヤジなダジャレ？」
dialogues.en: "...An old man's pun?"
dialogues.text: "...An old man's pun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それも違うね」
dialogues.en: "Wrooong."
dialogues.text: "Wrooong."

dialogues.jp: 一つ息をつく。
dialogues.en: I took a deep breath.
dialogues.text: I took a deep breath.

dialogues.jp: 気持ちのいい春の青空に向かって、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: Facing the beautiful blue spring sky, I opened my mouth.
dialogues.text: Facing the beautiful blue spring sky, I opened my mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「愛の告白と、ふたりの将来について」
dialogues.en: "A confession of love for our future."
dialogues.text: "A confession of love for our future."

dialogues.en: "...How's that?"
dialogues.text: "...How's that?"

dialogues.jp: 答えを求め、ことりへと目を向ける。
dialogues.en: Seeking for a response, I looked over to her.
dialogues.text: Seeking for a response, I looked over to her.

dialogues.jp: とても嬉しそうな笑顔が、そこにあった。
dialogues.en: I saw a beaming smile.
dialogues.text: I saw a beaming smile.

dialogues.jp: ことりはぐっと親指を立てると、言った。
dialogues.en: Kotori gave me the thumbs up, and said.
dialogues.text: Kotori gave me the thumbs up, and said.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「良く出来ました」
dialogues.en: "You've got it!"
dialogues.text: "You've got it!"

dialogues.jp: ◆ＥＤ・ふたりの将来？◆
dialogues.en: ◆ED. Our Future?◆
dialogues.text: ◆ED. Our Future?◆

dialogues.jp:
ぼろぼろ泣く暦先生を見るという貴重な経験を
した後、俺とことりは式場を抜け出した。
dialogues.en:
Kotori and I sneaked out of the wedding ceremony, talking
about the rare occasion of seeing Koyomi-sensei break down
in tears.
dialogues.text:
Kotori and I sneaked out of the wedding ceremony, talking
about the rare occasion of seeing Koyomi-sensei break down
in tears.

dialogues.jp:
５月の暖かい陽気の中、ことりとぴったりくっ
ついて歩く。すぐ隣には最愛の人の笑顔。
dialogues.en:
In the middle of the warm May weather, my beloved Kotori was
walking by my side, a brilliant smile on her face.
dialogues.text:
In the middle of the warm May weather, my beloved Kotori was
walking by my side, a brilliant smile on her face.

dialogues.jp:
身内だけの集まりの場で何を言ってくれるか期
待しちゃうなあ、と言葉通りの視線を向けてく
ることりに俺は言ってやった。
dialogues.en:
She then invited me to a gathering with her relatives, and
looked to me for a way to express the idea clearly.
dialogues.text:
She then invited me to a gathering with her relatives, and
looked to me for a way to express the idea clearly.

dialogues.jp: 「愛の告白と、ふたりの将来について」
dialogues.en: "A confession of love for our future."
dialogues.text: "A confession of love for our future."

dialogues.en: "...How's that?"
dialogues.text: "...How's that?"

dialogues.jp: とても嬉しそうな笑顔が、そこにあった。
dialogues.en: She nodded with an ever-beaming smile.
dialogues.text: She nodded with an ever-beaming smile.
